title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI quality gating + eval-metrics integration
author: Aditi Rao
description: Add per-prompt quality gating and eval-metrics integration to the eval-harness CI hooks. Motivation: teams need deterministic CI feedback when model changes affect specific prompt sets. This PR adds a per-prompt threshold config, a lightweight metrics reporter that surfaces prompt-level regressions to CI, and a gating layer that can fail the build when quality drops exceed configured tolerances. Includes documentation updates and an opt-in flag for running the heavier eval metrics in CI. Checklist: [x] implement per-prompt threshold config schema [x] hook into CI to fetch previous baseline metrics [x] emit structured eval metrics for CI dashboard [x] add unit and integration tests [x] update docs and quickstart. Related: ENG-342, ENG-355.

release_notes: Adds per-prompt quality gating to eval-harness CI hooks. Teams can configure thresholds per prompt-set to fail CI on regressions and opt into richer eval-metrics reporting. Includes docs and examples.
